title: SPK emissions beyond the 10 billion Genesis Supply are permanently disabled and Spark Governance cannot reverse it
content:
A.6.1.1.1.2.1.4.2.1.1.6 states that "token emissions beyond the Genesis Supply are permanently disabled; this cannot be reverted by Spark Governance."

The design move is to remove a power from the body that would most benefit from using it. Any token-issuing governance faces standing pressure to mint — for incentives, for treasury, for emergencies — and each mint is individually defensible. By making the supply cap unreachable by Spark Governance, the Artifact converts a policy intention into a structural fact, so SPK holders do not have to trust the Agent's future restraint.

This matters more for an Agent token than for a base-layer token, because Spark Governance is a narrower body than Sky Governance and its token is the primary instrument for aligning Spark's own contributors. Uncapped issuance under a narrow governance body is exactly the configuration where dilution risk is highest.

The cost is loss of flexibility: with issuance foreclosed, every future incentive programme must be funded out of the existing 10 billion allocation rather than from new supply. The Artifact accepts that constraint deliberately.
description: A one-way commitment: the Agent's own governance is stripped of the power to inflate its token, making supply credibility structural rather than a promise.
